features.name: price_spread
features.description: Difference between NSW and VIC electricity prices, capturing inter-regional price divergence
features.expected_model_benefit: Direct price differential is a strong signal for electricity flow direction and market conditions

features.name: demand_spread
features.description: Difference between NSW and VIC electricity demand, capturing inter-regional demand imbalance
features.expected_model_benefit: Demand imbalance between regions drives transfer decisions and price movements

features.name: price_ratio_nsw_vic
features.description: Ratio of NSW price to VIC price plus small epsilon to avoid division by zero, indicating relative price levels
features.expected_model_benefit: Relative price ratio captures multiplicative relationships that additive features miss; tree splits on ratio thresholds

features.name: transfer_demand_ratio
features.description: Ratio of transfer capacity to total combined demand, indicating how much transfer covers demand
features.expected_model_benefit: Transfer relative to demand captures whether grid can balance regional shortfalls

features.name: high_price_period
features.description: Boolean indicator for high NSW price combined with peak period (period > 0.5), flagging peak price events
features.expected_model_benefit: Boolean interaction captures nonlinear joint condition that trees can split on directly

features.name: demand_pressure_index
features.description: Combined demand pressure from both regions weighted by their respective prices
features.expected_model_benefit: Price-weighted demand captures economic pressure on the grid, a key driver of price movements

features.name: period_bucket
features.expected_model_benefit: Ordinal time buckets allow trees to split on time-of-day patterns without treating period as continuous

features.name: date_recency_bucket
features.description: Ordinal date bucket splitting dataset into early(0), mid-early(1), mid-late(2), recent(3) periods
features.expected_model_benefit: Date buckets capture structural shifts in electricity market over time without overfitting to exact dates

features.name: log_nsw_price
features.description: Log-transformed NSW price to compress right-skewed price distribution
features.expected_model_benefit: Log transformation reduces impact of extreme price spikes and creates more uniform split points for trees

features.name: transfer_efficiency
features.description: Transfer relative to maximum possible demand, indicating grid utilization efficiency
features.expected_model_benefit: Transfer efficiency relative to peak regional demand captures grid stress and flow direction signals

features.name: price_volatility_indicator
features.description: Semantic assessment of price volatility level based on NSW price magnitude: 0=very low(<0.02), 1=low(0.02-0.05), 2=moderate(0.05-0.1), 3=high(0.1-0.2), 4=extreme(>0.2)
features.expected_model_benefit: Ordinal volatility bucket provides interpretable price regime indicator that trees can split on cleanly

features.name: regional_imbalance_score
features.description: Semantic score of regional supply-demand imbalance combining price and demand differentials: 0=balanced, 1=mild imbalance, 2=moderate imbalance, 3=severe imbalance favoring NSW, 4=severe imbalance favoring VIC
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures complex multi-variable regional imbalance state that drives electricity transfer direction and price changes
